exposure: publication of the National Heavy Menstrual Bleeding Clinical Care Standard (HMB Standard) (before vs. after)
cohort: Patients undergoing planned benign hysterectomy in a single regional Victorian hospital were included, with groups defined by whether their surgery occurred in the 10 months before or 10 months after the publication of the HMB Standard in October 2017.
finding: There was no clinically significant change in low-value hysterectomy in the 10 months following publication of the HMB Standard compared to the 10 months prior, and uptake of therapeutic alternatives to hysterectomy remained low.
